content: Diya Menon discusses her expiring policy with insurance agent Anjali Desai. Diya confirms she wants to proceed with the previously discussed premium plan featuring dental and vision care. Anjali agrees to process the renewal and send a confirmation email by the end of the day, while Diya asks whether there will be any gap in coverage before the new policy takes effect.

action_items: Send a confirmation email with updated policy details by end of day
Clarify if there is a gap in coverage between policies
